title: pvHDF5RageReader
body:
## pvHDF5RageReader

Reads RAGE simulation output stored in HDF5 through an ASCII descriptor that lists the data files and the type and order of the variables (ParaView registers the .h5rage extension; the native text calls it a .pio file). The output is uniform image data with the selected variables as point arrays, one time step per data file.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Keep the descriptor and the HDF5 files it lists together.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so inspect the output blocks, arrays and time steps on your own files before relying on it.

Native constructor: `HDF5RageReader`. Identity: `sources/H5RageReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileName` | ASCII .pio file describes locations of data files, type and order of data written to the files. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `PointArrays` | Variables written to the data files are described in the .pio file and are presented for selection. Only selected variables are loaded for a time step. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvHDF5RageReader",
  "options": {
    "FileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
